name: What are the key differences between a standalone office structure and an attached home office addition?

mainEntity.name: What are the key differences between a standalone office structure and an attached home office addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between a standalone office structure and an attached home office addition involves weighing different benefits and considerations. An attached addition offers direct access from your main living space, often simplifying utility connections and maintaining a cohesive architectural style. A standalone structure, like an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) or a converted detached garage, provides maximum separation and privacy, which can be ideal for client meetings or minimizing household distractions. However, standalone structures often involve more extensive permitting and utility installations. AKN Design Group can discuss both options, helping you understand the implications for your specific property and lifestyle.
acceptedAnswer.description: An attached office addition offers direct home access and simplified utilities, while a standalone structure provides maximum privacy but may require more extensive permitting and utility work. Both have distinct advantages depending on your needs.
